# Original public legal fixtures

Downloaded from the official eCFR versioner endpoint on September 30, 2026:
`https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/2026-09-28/title-33.xml?section=SECTION`.

The section IDs are 165.1155, 165.1196 and 334.1130. These U.S. Government regulatory
texts support offline hash, coordinate and geometry tests. They are not a live
legal snapshot. Current source requests and policy hashes remain required before
publication. Exact hashes and receipt URLs are in
[the review receipt](../../../research/receipts/seafloor-regional-spatial-screen-review.json).
